description: This script automates the process of submitting security advisory updates to GitHub repositories via GitHub CLI commands. It handles parsing command-line arguments, retrieving repository information, constructing payloads for advisories, and updating security advisories on GitHub. The script is designed for maintenance and publication of security vulnerability information related to npm packages.

methods.name: usage
methods.description: Displays usage instructions for the script in case of incorrect invocation.

methods.name: fail
methods.description: Outputs an error message and terminates the process.

methods.name: parseArgs
methods.description: Parses command-line arguments into an object, expecting specific flags with their values.

methods.name: runGh
methods.description: Executes GitHub CLI commands synchronously and handles errors.

methods.name: deriveRepoFromOrigin
methods.description: Extracts the GitHub repository identifier from the 'origin' remote URL.

methods.name: parseGhsaId
methods.description: Validates and extracts the GHSA ID from the provided input.

methods.name: writeTempJson
methods.description: Writes a JSON object to a temporary file and returns its path.
